content: To inspect the effect of the additional forget gate, we investigate how the values of vertical forget gates are distributed. We sample 1,000 random sentences from the development set of the SNLI dataset, and use the 3-layer CAS-LSTM model trained on the SNLI dataset to compute gate values.
